retryQueueCancelCleanup.result: Accepted-input, queue and lease ownership, native overflow retry, compaction fail/cancel, running PowerShell cancellation, invalid resume fallback, crash cleanup and planned shutdown passed with no late file effect.

limitations: The evidence scope is Windows 10 x64 on a healthy local fixed NTFS volume; Windows 11, network filesystems, macOS x64 and Linux x64 are not inferred.

An earlier production-TTL observation tracked Windows descendants by PID alone and could not distinguish PID reuse. It is not used as evidence; the accepted rerun tracked PID plus WMI CreationDate and passed the same production 30-minute TTL.
ACP still lacks session/load, additionalDirectories, a manual compact command, compaction lifecycle, MCP SSE/resources/prompts and client filesystem/terminal bridges.

The controlled overflow injects one context-window error at the official llm/stream seam and exercises the real native summarizer and automatic retry; it does not claim a naturally exhausted provider window.
Missing cache-write, reasoning and cost fields remain unknown as reported by the provider.
Credentials, raw prompts, machine paths, Native Session IDs, Run IDs and full tool output are excluded.

qualificationBasis.decision: All 14 Runtime integration axes are independently verified on the stated Windows x64 host envelope. This is Adapter behavior qualification, not a packaged application release or a cross-platform claim.
